items.name: 1. Spec compliance
items.note: All six acceptance criteria and the operator decisions (numbers kept, AC-Move-Map, two PRs) are implemented; spec-reviewer APPROVE.

items.name: 2. Error handling
items.note: Unsafe shapes raise SplitError (exit 2); apply restores every file on any failure incl. Ctrl-C; restore failures are named.

items.name: 3. Security basics
items.note: No shell interpolation: subprocess calls use argv lists; the grouping is data, never executed; no secrets.

items.name: 4. Test quality
items.note: 41 tests assert outcomes (bytes before/after, exit codes, conservation negatives); error paths for each refusal.

items.name: 5. Performance basics
items.note: One repo walk for evidence; two manifest regenerations only on --apply (about 12 s each on this repo).

items.name: 6. Naming and structure
items.note: Pure lib modules plus one tool; every file under 300 lines (fr_split.py 299); tests split into three files.

items.name: 7. Affected boundaries
items.note: Boundaries: spec.md text, test files, coverage baseline, AC registry, regenerated traceability manifest; each has a conservation or restore check.

items.name: 8. Docs and follow-ups
items.note: fr-authoring 3c and guide I10 paragraph updated; deferred doubt findings listed in the iterate spec.
